envelope.description: Define activity execution contracts and inactivity monitor

body.title: Define activity execution contracts and inactivity monitor
body.summary: Introduce bounded/activity execution union, provider capability, host-owned 30-minute monotonic monitor, separately tracked tools and bounded factual diagnostic snapshots. Preserve non-task bounded calls; explicitly refuse unsupported Ollama task mode before execution.
acceptanceChecks: Activity mode forbids fixed deadlines/stall watchdogs and automatic retries; malformed mixed options reject
Meaningful activity extends 30-minute grace; heartbeat, poll and duplicate events do not; tool IDs/ages remain separate
Monotonic fake-clock expiry and injected local-pressure/unknown diagnostics are deterministic
Ollama opt-in task activity refuses before model calls; existing bounded behavior unchanged

tests.name: Fake-clock monitor: progress beyond expected duration, 1800000ms expiry, no heartbeat/replay renewal and separate tool ages
Execution union rejects mixed timers; capability/Ollama refusal before execution; factual diagnostic classification
